## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, and `bun run test` all pass
- [ ] If this touches a probe (sensor, location, haptics, biometrics, deep
      links, ...), I tested it on a **physical device**, not just a
      simulator/emulator
- [ ] User-visible strings are added to both `en.json` and `fr.json`
- [ ] New native subscriptions are cleaned up on unmount
